name: deadline_headroom
idea: Allocate headroom by energy urgency.
objective: Meet departures within network capacity.
research: adaptation

strategies.label: Immediate
strategies.observations: current connected sessions and grid state

strategies.description: Wait until the configured start hour.
strategies.label: Fixed delay
strategies.observations: current connected sessions and grid state

strategies.label: Randomized delay
strategies.observations: current connected sessions and grid state

strategies.description: Departure-first allocation within capacity budgets and AC checks.
strategies.label: Capacity aware
strategies.observations: current connected sessions and grid state

strategies.description: Allocate headroom to sessions with the least time slack.
strategies.label: Least laxity first
strategies.limitation: Plain LLF, not the cited smoothed LLF algorithm.
strategies.observations: current connected sessions and grid state

strategies.description: Coordinate-descent water filling flattens forecast demand for connected sessions.
strategies.forecast: explicit causal persistence or previous-day baseline; no future arrivals
strategies.label: Valley filling
strategies.limitation: Finite coordinate-descent iterations; no optimality guarantee; current action projected to capacity budgets.
strategies.observations: current connected sessions and grid state

strategies.description: Re-solve a capacity-constrained linear program; prioritize energy delivery, then peak.
strategies.forecast: explicit causal persistence or previous-day baseline; no future arrivals
strategies.label: Model predictive control
strategies.limitation: Finite-horizon approximation with reported LLF fallback; AC feasibility checked after action.
strategies.observations: current connected sessions and grid state

strategies.description: Use previous measured block voltage with gradual recovery.
strategies.label: Voltage responsive
strategies.limitation: Balanced MV block voltage, not physical charger/LV voltage. Central safety overlay may intervene.

strategies.description: A frozen trained model chooses per-session on/off actions.
strategies.label: Learned on/off policy
